title: ROS 2 binding for the Common Command Registry
registry: Common Command Registry for Uncrewed Systems (UAV, UGV, USV, UUV)
note: Generated from Annexes A, B and C of the ROS 2 binding. Tier 1 is standard ROS 2 and Nav2, Tier 2 the autopilot bridges, Tier 3 the proposed uxs_interfaces package.

surveyedPackages.relevance: Nav2 actions (navigation, behaviors, docking, waypoints) and services
Sensor data types; only `SetCameraInfo` is a service
MAVLink bridge: commands, gimbal, missions, triggers

examples.uxs_interfaces/action/VehicleGoto.action:
# Go to position: Move to a position, then stop or continue to the next instruction.
# Registry command: http://www.opengis.net/def/uxs-command/vehicle.goto
# Completion: until-goal; persistence: none; hazard: flight-critical; level: Core
# Note: For Routes waypoints, location is a context parameter filled from the waypoint geometry.
# Goal
uxs_interfaces/Position location	# Target position.
float64 speed	# Desired speed. Reference given by the platform default (ground speed for UGV, water-relative for USV/UUV, air or ground speed for UAV). [m/s] Optional; NaN means unset.
float64 acceptance_radius	# Distance from the target at which the target counts as reached. [m] Optional; NaN means unset.
float64 hold_time	# Time to remain at the position after arrival before completing. [s] Optional; NaN means unset.
float64 heading	# Heading to hold on arrival. [rad] Optional; NaN means unset.
uint8 pass_through	# If true the vehicle does not stop at the position and may pass within acceptanceRadius. Optional; see tri-state constants.
uint8 PASS_THROUGH_FALSE = 0
uint8 PASS_THROUGH_TRUE = 1
uint8 PASS_THROUGH_UNSET = 255
---
# Result
bool success
uint16 error_code
uint16 ERROR_NONE = 0
uint16 ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_PARAMETER = 1
uint16 ERROR_INVALID_VALUE = 2
uint16 ERROR_PRECONDITION_FAILED = 3
uint16 ERROR_TIMEOUT = 4
uint16 ERROR_HARDWARE_FAULT = 5
uint16 ERROR_UNKNOWN = 99
string message	# Explanation when success is false.
---
# Feedback
float32 progress	# 0.0 to 1.0, NaN if unknown.
builtin_interfaces/Duration elapsed
examples.uxs_interfaces/action/CameraCaptureImage:
# Capture image: Capture still images.
# Registry command: http://www.opengis.net/def/uxs-command/camera.capture-image
# Completion: until-goal; persistence: none; hazard: none; level: Core
# Goal
int32 count	# Number of images. 0 means continue until camera.stop-image-capture. Optional; -1 means unset.
float64 interval	# Time between images. [s] Optional; NaN means unset.
---
# Result
bool success
uint16 error_code
uint16 ERROR_NONE = 0

uint16 ERROR_INVALID_VALUE = 2
uint16 ERROR_PRECONDITION_FAILED = 3
uint16 ERROR_TIMEOUT = 4
uint16 ERROR_HARDWARE_FAULT = 5
uint16 ERROR_UNKNOWN = 99
string message	# Explanation when success is false.
string[] data_uris	# URIs of the produced images.
---
# Feedback
float32 progress	# 0.0 to 1.0, NaN if unknown.
builtin_interfaces/Duration elapsed
examples.uxs_interfaces/srv/SensorGetStatus.srv:
# Get status: Return the state and health of the sensor.
# Registry command: http://www.opengis.net/def/uxs-command/sensor.get-status
# Completion: immediate; persistence: none; hazard: none; level: Core
# Request
---
# Response
bool success
uint16 error_code
uint16 ERROR_NONE = 0
uint16 ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_PARAMETER = 1
uint16 ERROR_INVALID_VALUE = 2
uint16 ERROR_PRECONDITION_FAILED = 3
uint16 ERROR_TIMEOUT = 4
uint16 ERROR_HARDWARE_FAULT = 5
uint16 ERROR_UNKNOWN = 99
string message	# Explanation when success is false.
uint8 state	# State: 0 off, 1 standby, 2 idle, 3 acquiring, 4 busy, 5 fault.
uint8 health	# Health: 0 ok, 1 degraded, 2 failed.
string status_message	# Message.
examples.uxs_interfaces/msg/Position.msg:
# Geographic position with an optional vertical component.
# Registry type: http://www.opengis.net/def/uxs-command/type/Position
float64 latitude	# deg, WGS 84
float64 longitude	# deg, WGS 84
float64 vertical	# m; NaN if unset. Positive up, except depth (positive down).
uint8 vertical_reference	# see VERTICAL_REFERENCE_*
uint8 VERTICAL_REFERENCE_ELLIPSOID = 0
uint8 VERTICAL_REFERENCE_MSL = 1
uint8 VERTICAL_REFERENCE_TERRAIN = 2
uint8 VERTICAL_REFERENCE_HOME = 3
uint8 VERTICAL_REFERENCE_DEPTH = 4
uint8 VERTICAL_REFERENCE_SEABED = 5
uint8 VERTICAL_REFERENCE_UNSET = 255

bindings.name: NavigateToPose
bindings.conversions: lat/lon → map frame with `robot_localization` service `/fromLL` (`GeoPoint` → `Point`); ENU yaw = π/2 − heading (rad), wrapped to (−π, π\]; quaternion about z
bindings.notes: `speed`, `acceptanceRadius`, `holdTime`, `passThrough` are not goal fields (controller and goal-checker parameters). They are dropped with a warning (REC 3).

bindings.name: FollowGPSWaypoints
bindings.conversions: Nav2 converts lat/lon itself through `/fromLL`; ENU yaw = π/2 − heading (rad), wrapped to (−π, π\]; quaternion about z
bindings.notes: Single-element list. Same unsupported parameters as above.

bindings.name: CommandInt
bindings.conversions: degE7 integer conversion; frame from vertical reference
bindings.notes: Guided-mode reposition; supports `speed`, `heading` (param4 yaw).

bindings.name: FollowGPSWaypoints
bindings.conversions: Nav2 converts lat/lon; orientations derived from path direction
bindings.notes: Waypoint task executors run at each waypoint and are configured by parameters, not per goal.

bindings.name: NavigateThroughPoses
bindings.notes: Through-poses planning; `interpolation` is planner-defined.

bindings.name: FollowPath
bindings.notes: Follows a given path exactly; no planning. `speed` is not a goal field.

bindings.name: Wait
bindings.notes: Ground vehicles only (robot stays stationary). `holdMode`, `radius`, `location` unsupported; unlimited duration unsupported.

bindings.name: CommandInt
bindings.parameterMap: `DO_ORBIT` (34): `radius` → param1 (sign = direction), `speed` → param2, `center` → x, y, z
bindings.notes: `turns`, `duration` unsupported.

bindings.name: Spin
bindings.conversions: relative yaw = wrap(ENU yaw target − current yaw from TF); ENU yaw = π/2 − heading (rad), wrapped to (−π, π\]; quaternion about z
bindings.notes: `target_yaw` is a relative rotation in radians. `rate`, `lock` unsupported.

bindings.name: DriveOnHeading
bindings.notes: Forward motion only (`bearing` = 0 relative to vehicle). `verticalDistance` unsupported.

bindings.name: BackUp
bindings.notes: Used for `bearing` = 180°; the behavior always drives backwards, whatever the sign of `target.x`.

bindings.name: SetMode
bindings.parameterMap: `destination` = home → `custom_mode` of the RTL mode (autopilot specific)
bindings.notes: Mode names depend on the autopilot (for example `RTL`).

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: `finalAction` and `vertical` are not carried.

bindings.name: CancelGoal
bindings.parameterMap: `mode` = controlled → cancel all goals on the movement action servers (goal id zero, stamp zero)
bindings.notes: Stops by cancellation; the platform then holds. For `immediate`, also publish a zero `geometry_msgs/Twist` on the velocity command topic.

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: `rate` unsupported.

bindings.name: CommandTOL
bindings.conversions: degrees; float32 latitude/longitude (resolution ≈ 0.4 m at 45° N): unsuitable where metre accuracy matters; prefer `CommandInt` (int32 degE7)
bindings.notes: `climbRate` unsupported. `min_pitch` left 0.

bindings.name: VehicleCommand
bindings.notes: PX4 uXRCE-DDS; ack on `VehicleCommandAck`. A `px4_msgs/srv/VehicleCommand` service (request `VehicleCommand`, reply `VehicleCommandAck`) is also defined.

bindings.name: CommandTOL
bindings.conversions: degrees; float32 latitude/longitude (resolution ≈ 0.4 m at 45° N): unsuitable where metre accuracy matters; prefer `CommandInt` (int32 degE7)
bindings.notes: `descentRate`, `precision`, `disarmAfter` unsupported.

bindings.name: DockRobot
bindings.notes: `action` = dock. `heading` unsupported.

bindings.name: SpeedLimit
bindings.notes: Nav2 controller server subscribes to it. `speedType`, `throttle` unsupported. Topic, not a service: completion is immediate without acknowledgment.

bindings.name: SetMode
bindings.notes: Generic modes have no standard string mapping.

bindings.name: CommandBool
bindings.notes: `force` unsupported (send through `CommandLong` with the force code under explicit authorization).

bindings.name: SetBool
bindings.notes: Convention for drivers that expose arming as SetBool. No standard service name.

bindings.name: CommandHome
bindings.conversions: degrees; float32 latitude/longitude (resolution ≈ 0.4 m at 45° N): unsuitable where metre accuracy matters; prefer `CommandInt` (int32 degE7)

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: Destructive: separate authorization required.

bindings.name: ManageLifecycleNodes
bindings.notes: Pauses the Nav2 lifecycle nodes. `behavior` unsupported.

bindings.name: CancelGoal
bindings.parameterMap: cancel all goals, then issue the fallback (`hold`, `return-to-home`, `land`, `surface`, `stop`) as a new command (REC 28)
bindings.notes: Composite of cancel and another registry command.

bindings.name: Wait
bindings.notes: Ground behavior. Not suitable for aerial vehicles that must keep flying.

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: Destructive. There is no standard ROS 2 emergency-stop service.

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: Destructive: separate authorization required.

bindings.name: ChangeState
bindings.notes: Applies to sensor driver nodes that are lifecycle nodes. Physical power switching is outside ROS.

bindings.name: SetBool
bindings.notes: Convention for drivers. `standby` unsupported.

bindings.name: Trigger
bindings.notes: Convention for drivers. `duration`, `sampleCount`, `rate` unsupported; `rate` is set through `SetParameters`.

bindings.name: ChangeState
bindings.notes: Lifecycle drivers publish only while active.

bindings.name: Trigger
bindings.notes: Convention for drivers.

bindings.name: Trigger
bindings.notes: Convention for camera and sensor drivers. `count` and `interval` unsupported (call repeatedly).

bindings.name: SetParameters
bindings.notes: Parameter name is driver-specific and declared in the System description.

bindings.name: MessageInterval
bindings.notes: MAVLink message streams only.

bindings.name: SetParameters
bindings.parameterMap: `configuration` → parameter file or parameter set identified by name
bindings.notes: Named configuration sets are a deployment convention.

bindings.name: SetCameraInfo
bindings.notes: Stores the result of a calibration, it does not perform one.

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: Flight-critical for vehicle-state sensors.

bindings.name: SelfTest
bindings.notes: `level` unsupported (the service has no request fields).

bindings.name: ChangeState
bindings.notes: `scope` granularity unsupported.

bindings.name: GetState
bindings.notes: `health` from the `/diagnostics` topic (`DiagnosticStatus.level`: OK, WARN, ERROR, STALE).

bindings.name: Record
bindings.notes: `storage` and `maxDuration` unsupported. Response is `return_code` and `error_string`.

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: MAVLink camera protocol. Produced image location is not returned.

bindings.name: PhotoAtWaypoint
bindings.parameterMap: one image at each waypoint, configured by parameters
bindings.notes: Plugin of the Nav2 waypoint follower. Per-waypoint parameters are not possible.

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: `maxDuration`, `label` unsupported.

bindings.name: CommandTriggerInterval
bindings.notes: Distance-based triggering uses `CommandLong` `DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST` (206).

bindings.name: GimbalManagerPitchyaw
bindings.conversions: degrees and deg/s (passed through to the MAVLink command); radians → degrees
bindings.notes: `roll` unsupported. `gimbal_device_id` 0 = all.

bindings.name: MountConfigure
bindings.notes: Older mount protocol.

bindings.name: GimbalManagerSetRoi
bindings.conversions: degrees; float32 latitude/longitude (resolution ≈ 0.4 m at 45° N): unsuitable where metre accuracy matters; prefer `CommandInt` (int32 degE7)

bindings.name: PointHead
bindings.notes: For pan-tilt heads driven through TF; `pointing_axis`, `min_duration` from configuration.

bindings.name: GimbalManagerPitchyaw
bindings.parameterMap: `stow` → `flags` RETRACT (1); `follow` → no lock flags; `lock` → lock flags (4, 8, 16)
bindings.notes: Angles are left unset.

bindings.name: GripperCommand
bindings.conversions: position in metres or radians as the gripper defines
bindings.notes: Mapping of open/close to positions is gripper configuration.

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: Airframe specific.

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: `intensity` and `lightId` unsupported.

bindings.name: CommandLong
bindings.notes: Flight-critical.
